blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー9
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy IX

blocks.source: 物語
blocks.translation: Story

blocks.source: ＦＦシリーズとしては、久々の王道ファンタジーでＳＦ色は弱め。シナリオは珍しく坂口博信氏がメインで書いている。原点回帰がウリで、今までのＦＦシリーズで出てきた用語などが頻繁に使用されている。
blocks.translation: As far as the FF series goes, this is a classic fantasy setting—the first in a long time—with only a weak sci-fi element. The scenario is unusual in that Hironobu Sakaguchi himself serves as the main writer. A return to the series' roots is its selling point, with terms and other elements from previous FF games appearing frequently.

blocks.source: ＦＦ７・８同様にストーリー主導型の作品であり、演劇から始まるオープニングなど実に派手。そのまま中盤までは途切れなくイベントが発生する。
blocks.translation: Like FFVII and FFVIII, this is a story-driven game, with a remarkably flashy opening that begins with a stage play. Events then continue to occur without interruption through the middle of the game.

blocks.source: 王道ファンタジーＲＰＧらしく、広く多様な世界を期待していたのだが、最初の大陸以外は荒れ果てているという設定。せっかく、飛空艇で空を自在に飛べるようになっても、あまり見るべき場所がないのは残念。
blocks.translation: As befits a classic fantasy RPG, I expected a broad and diverse world, but the setting establishes that everything beyond the first continent is desolate. Even after finally gaining the ability to freely fly through the skies in an airship, it is disappointing that there are so few places worth seeing.

blocks.source: なんとなく盛り上がりに乏しい印象があるのだけど、一つにはストーリーとボス戦が噛み合ってないのだと思う。
blocks.translation: I have the vague impression that it lacks excitement, and I think one reason is that the story and boss battles do not mesh well.

blocks.source: 同じ敵との強制敗北戦闘が何度もある。しかも、相手のベアトリクスは凄腕とはいえ単なる人間。シナリオ上、強大な敵というわけでもなく、負けなければならない理由が見当たらない。
blocks.translation: There are numerous forced-loss battles against the same enemy. What is more, the opponent, Beatrix, is merely human, albeit exceptionally skilled. She is not a powerful enemy from a story standpoint, so there is no apparent reason why you have to lose.

blocks.source: 逆に本当に強大な敵であるはずのクジャやガーランドとの戦いは、イベントバトル同然で普通にやれば負けない。
blocks.translation: Conversely, battles against Kuja and Garland, who should be truly formidable enemies, are effectively event battles that you cannot lose if you fight normally.

blocks.source: 伏線も無く唐突に出現するラスボス。
blocks.translation: The final boss appears suddenly, without any foreshadowing.

blocks.source: こうしてみると山場でのガチバトルに乏しいので、印象的なボス戦が欲しかった。強制敗北戦闘ってやらされてる感があるから、多用しちゃいかんなと。
blocks.translation: Looking at it this way, the game lacks serious battles at its climaxes, so I wanted some more memorable boss fights. Forced-loss battles make you feel like you are merely being made to go through the motions, so they should not be overused.

blocks.source: 今回の主人公ジタンは熱血タイプ。ＦＦ７・８のクール系主人公とは違って好対照。ただ、仲間キャラごとの扱いにわりと差がある。クイナはおまけとしても、フライヤやサラマンダーにも、もう少しいい見せ場が欲しかったところ。
blocks.translation: This game's protagonist, Zidane, is a hot-blooded type—a striking contrast to the cool protagonists of FFVII and FFVIII. However, the supporting characters receive noticeably different levels of treatment. Quina can be considered an extra, but Freya and Salamander also deserved better moments to shine.

blocks.source: システム／バランス
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance

blocks.source: パーティは仲間８人の中から４人を選んで編成する。ＦＦ７～８と違って、今作はキャラクター毎の戦闘での役割が明確。逆にこういうシンプルな構成のほうが、新鮮に感じる部分もあってよいかも。
blocks.translation: You form your party by choosing four members from among eight companions. Unlike FFVII and FFVIII, this game clearly defines each character's role in battle. Conversely, this kind of simple setup can feel refreshing, which is a good thing.

blocks.source: ただし、後半までストーリー展開に合わせてコロコロとパーティ編成が変わる。
blocks.translation: However, the party composition keeps changing repeatedly in accordance with the story's progression until the latter half.

blocks.source: 戦闘は今まで通りのＡＴＢだが、戦闘テンポが遅く、上手く機能していないところも。やっぱり、テンポあってのＡＴＢだなと認識させられる。
blocks.translation: Battles use the familiar ATB system, but the battle tempo is slow, and some aspects do not function well. It really drives home that the ATB system depends on having a good pace.

blocks.source: 装備に応じて能力を身に着ける成長システムは複雑すぎず、なおかつそれなりに自由度もある。システム面で大きな冒険をしていた前作と違って無難かもしれないが、良くできている。
blocks.translation: The growth system, in which characters acquire abilities based on their equipment, is neither too complicated nor lacking in freedom. It may be more conservative than the previous game, which took bold steps with its systems, but it is well designed.

blocks.source: 難易度はシリーズの中でも、若干低め。準備を整えていれば、ボス戦でもあっという間に片付くことも。システムはシンプルな割に、ゲームバランスには大味なところも。極端に武器の威力に依存する戦闘計算式のせいで、武器を変えただけでもバランスが激変する。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is slightly low compared with other games in the series. If you are properly prepared, even boss battles can sometimes be finished in no time. Despite its simple systems, the game balance can be rather rough. Because the battle formula depends excessively on weapon power, the balance changes dramatically simply by changing weapons.

blocks.source: このゲームシステムならば、キャラクター毎の能力調整が肝となるはずだが、微妙なところかも。
blocks.translation: With this game system, adjusting each character's abilities should be crucial, but that aspect may be somewhat lacking.

blocks.source: 特にヒロインのガーネットがエーコに優る点がほとんど見当たらないのが悲しい。ヘイスト、エスナ、アレイズ、ホーリーといった重要白魔法に、召喚魔法も聖属性で使いやすいマディーン、全体蘇生のフェニックスとエーコが至れり尽くせりなのに対して、ガーネットはこれといった魔法を覚えない。
blocks.translation: It is particularly unfortunate that Garnet, the heroine, has almost no advantages over Eiko. While Eiko has important White Magic such as Haste, Esuna, Arise, and Holy, as well as easy-to-use Holy-element summons like Madeen and Phoenix, which revives the entire party, Garnet does not learn any particularly notable magic.

blocks.source: リミット技や特殊技に変わる要素として、今回はトランスがある。ただ、強すぎてゲーム中盤からダメージ９９９９を連発できてしまう。しかも、今回は連続ヒット技がほとんどないため、与えられるダメージはそこで頭打ち。これは今までよりスケールダウンした感があるので、どうにかしてほしかった。
blocks.translation: This time, Trance serves as the element replacing Limit Techniques and special techniques. However, it is too powerful, allowing you to repeatedly deal 9,999 damage from the middle of the game onward. Moreover, since there are almost no multi-hit techniques this time, the damage you can deal hits a ceiling there. It feels like a step down from previous games, and I wish something had been done about it.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: 戦闘開始までの時間がＦＦ８よりもさらに長く、戦闘開始と同時に「とんずら」しただけでも、かなりの時間がかかる。他の戦闘テンポ自体も遅めで、申し訳程度に召喚獣の演出ショートカット機能が付いている。ＦＦ８のように通常戦闘を減らす手段がないのも困る。
blocks.translation: The time until battles begin is even longer than in FFVIII, and even simply using “Flee” as soon as a battle starts takes a considerable amount of time. The overall battle tempo is also slow, with only a perfunctory shortcut function for summon animations. It is also inconvenient that there is no way to reduce random encounters as there was in FFVIII.

blocks.source: 原点回帰をうたうなら、ＳＦＣ時代の様なテンポの良さにも、回帰してもらいたかったというのが本音。ここがもっとマシだったなら、万人に勧められるＲＰＧになったと思うけれど……。
blocks.translation: If this is meant to be a return to the series' roots, honestly, I also wanted it to return to the brisk pace of the SNES era. If this aspect had been better, I think it could have become an RPG I would recommend to anyone, but...

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: ムービーシーンの量は前作ＦＦ８から、さらに増加。キャラクターの頭身がＦＦ７・８のリアル路線から、３頭身のコミカル路線に戻っているので、違和感あるかも知れない。
blocks.translation: The amount of movie scenes has increased even further from the previous game, FFVIII. The characters have returned from FFVII and FFVIII's realistic proportions to a comical, super-deformed style with three-head-tall proportions, which may feel jarring.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 作曲は全曲がおなじみの植松伸夫氏。戦闘音楽はＦＦ６以前のイントロから始まる。また、過去作品のアレンジ曲もいくつかあるなど、さすがは原点回帰といったところ。その他の曲も多様で高品質だ。
blocks.translation: All the music was composed by the familiar Nobuo Uematsu. The battle music begins with an intro reminiscent of the games up through FFVI. There are also several arranged pieces from previous games, making this truly a return to the series' roots. The other tracks are also diverse and high quality.
